decisions: Claimant read at publish time (one query per notifying person event of a listed type); a retry follows the current claim; no migration.
Mention suppression reads comment.created payload mentions[].session_id; no new payload field.
Not routed to the claimant: person ask.edited/ask.opened, artifact.version, suggestion.* (outside the architect's list).
Claim result text changes; the generic notSubscribed hint stays (it describes every event).
A claimant who already follows the ask is listed once, as a follower; dialog text accounts for the claim.
